label: GridTokenReader
info:
Prepaid meter camera (github.com/afardana/GridTokenReader).

Endpoints sit behind the nginx token gate (docs/NGINX.md): a per-device bearer token is checked there (/etc/nginx/gridtoken/tokens.map) and mapped to X-Device-Id, and nginx adds httpNodeAuth. Frames: /var/lib/gridtoken/frames (30-day retention). InfluxDB: gridtoken_ingest (device health), pln_prepaid (kWh readings).
